remarks:
Welcome to exceptional waterfront living at 2427 Lakeside Drive in beautiful Ashville, New York. Situated in a peaceful Chautauqua County lakeside community, this fully furnished turnkey retreat rests on two beautifully landscaped lots offering one hundred feet of pristine canal frontage. You will enjoy direct access to Chautauqua Lake, allowing you to easily board your boat and cruise into open water whenever you desire. The property provides ample space to dock two boats right at your doorstep. When you prefer recreation on land, the nearby community park features tennis and pickleball courts, ball fields, and a wonderful playground.

Inside this inviting home, a bright and open layout is perfectly designed for both entertaining and relaxation. The kitchen boasts elegant vaulted ceilings and flows seamlessly into the dining and living areas, creating a welcoming atmosphere for gathering with friends and family. The residence offers two comfortable bedrooms, two full bathrooms, and a generous loft that effortlessly accommodates your overnight guests. Picture enjoying your morning coffee on the charming front porch, followed by evenings gathered around the backyard firepit as the sun sets. The spacious front yard is beautifully enhanced by mature landscaping, lush greenery, and vibrant flowering accents that deliver exceptional curb appeal and a wonderful sense of privacy.

The detached garage is on a separately deeded lot offering the potential for independent water/sewer connections creating an outstanding opportunity to add living space or an additional lucrative rental property. The current home already boasts a strong short term rental history, making it an excellent investment, an idyllic vacation getaway that generates income. 

Just minutes away from the delightful shops, dining, and marinas of Lakewood. With premier golf courses and excellent ski resorts located nearby, you can easily embrace outdoor adventures throughout every season. Opportunities to secure a versatile and beautifully appointed property like this are truly rare, so seize the chance to experience the ultimate Chautauqua Lake lifestyle today.
